paragraphs: RESA develops and sells computer systems built for the operational needs of the airport industry, and the site dates that work to 1991. Their own page describes the software as covering passenger and baggage operations, flights, resource allocation, airport billing and flight information display.

The site labels CREWS as its CUPPS, ON BOARD as its DCS and LAYER ONE as its solution for centralising the data exchanges of a DCS. Other named lines are PAXTRACK and BAGERA, presented as answering security and traceability requirements for passengers and their bags. INFOPAX is given as an airport information system, INVOICE as billing software for the airport world and VISTA as a flight information display system. A third group covers FAIRWAY for information exchange, CLEVER for business intelligence and BAGWAY for baggage message distribution.

On buyers, the pages say the systems serve airports of every size, and count 300+ airports in 60+ countries, 450+ airlines and 700+ million passengers a year. Testimonials on the page are credited to an operations manager at FAAN, given there as the civil aviation of Nigéria, and to a director at VINCI Airports. That page also places RESA on platforms of all sizes, from regional sites up to airports handling more than 100 million passengers a year.

quote.text: Depuis 1991, RESA développe et commercialise à travers le monde des systèmes informatiques répondant aux besoins opérationnels des acteurs de l’industrie aéroportuaire
